content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Lakewood

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your education and work history before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training course. Attend all sessions from your Lakewood location or anywhere with internet access. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full curriculum required by PMI, preparing you for exam content and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP® application, including proof of education, experience, and your Granite PM Academy training certificate. Pay PMI's exam fee through their portal. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and study guides. Schedule your exam at an authorized Pearson Vue testing center. On exam day, answer 180 questions in three hours. Our instructors remain available to answer clarifying questions during your final prep.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold the PMP® credential for three years. Renew by earning 60 professional development units (PDUs) through PMI-approved training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or self-study. Plan your PDU activities throughout the cycle to maintain your credential and stay current in the field.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
